# Disk

Get the disk usage of target hosts. `osapi behavior get --name disk` and `osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method get

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Name | get |
| Verb | read |
| Description | Get the disk usage of the host |
| Detail | Reads the size, the used space and the free space of each local filesystem, in bytes: the mounts of /proc/mounts on Linux and of mount on macOS, with their sizes from df. Local is ext4, xfs and btrfs on Linux, and apfs and hfs on macOS. Network and special filesystems are left out. |
| HTTP | GET |
| Route | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/disk |
| Permission | disk:read |
| Command | [osapi client node disk get](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/disk/get.md) |
| Input type | GetInput |
| Output type | Entry |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.
